newsitem.title: USA: Clinton has 206 of 270 college votes needed -ABC TV.
newsitem.headline: Clinton has 206 of 270 college votes needed -ABC TV.

text.p: President Clinton had won 206 of the 270 Electoral College votes needed to win the presidency after polls closed in 28 states, ABC news reported on Tuesday.

The network said Republican challenger Bob Dole had won 55 electoral votes by 8 p.m. EST (0100 GMT Wednesday). Clinton took major victories in Florida, Ohio, and New Hampshire while the only big state picked up by Dole was Texas.
